notes:
I don't have any notes on Hosea 12 for you yet. The research tool stopped working before I could read a single page.

I tried to load six sources at once: Enduring Word on Hosea 12, Precept Austin's Hosea 12 page, two Bible Hub verse pages (12:1 and 12:4), and Gill's and Ellicott's chapter commentaries on Bible Hub. A bug in my script stopped it before it showed me what came back. When I tried again to look at the results, I'd reached my limit of tool calls for this turn, so I couldn't read any of the text.

You asked me to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written anything about any verse, any tradition or any other view. Anything I wrote now would come from memory, not from the sources.

If you send another message (even just "continue"), I'll start again in this order:
1. **Traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub and StudyLight.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** Wesley's notes on wesley.nnu.edu, Spurgeon on Jacob wrestling with God (vv. 3–4), and any Desiring God, Ligonier or GTY pieces on these verses.
3. **Other views:** the NET Bible notes (for example, who weeps in v. 4, and how to translate v. 8), Bible Odyssey, and Church Fathers or Catholic material on New Advent. I'll include popular modern teaching only if these sites actually discuss it in connection with this chapter.

The notes will be written "v. 4: …" with a URL after each point, and I'll leave out anything I can't find.
